surfaces: ee context (soft-deprecated alias, same hydration lane)

trigger.description: An imported evidence-span document (source=import) matched the retrieval query, but the span has not been distilled into a memory (memory_id is unset — the common state for a fresh `ee import cass`), or its recorded memory linkage was invalid. Pack candidates are memory-centric, so an undistilled span cannot hydrate into a pack item; the response degrades honestly with the distillation path as the repair instead of silently dropping the matched evidence. The excerpt remains retrievable via ee search.
setup_commands: ee import cass --workspace . --limit 1   # spans persist with memory_id unset
trigger.invocation: ee pack "<unique transcript phrase from the imported session>" --workspace . --json

message_contains: has not been distilled into a memory
